company.name: NuMind
company.shortDescription: NuMind is a SAAS company that offers data scientists, analysts and software engineers AI tools to create custom NLP models.
company.description: NuMind allows users to design unique machine learning models to automatically interpret text. Ideal for sentiment analysis, topic detection, content control, and more. There is no need for special knowledge.

productsAndServices.description: A foundation large language model designed for structured information extraction from documents, converting text into structured data formats.
productsAndServices.name: NuExtract

productsAndServices.description: A desktop application for creating custom NLP models focused on information extraction tasks like classification and named entity recognition without sharing data externally.
productsAndServices.name: NuMind Desktop Tool

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven platform enabling users with technical expertise to extract structured information from documents at scale using NuExtract.
productsAndServices.name: NuMind API Platform

productsAndServices.description: A deployment option allowing organizations to run customized AI models locally to maintain data privacy and control over sensitive information.
productsAndServices.name: On-Premises Enterprise Deployment

productsAndServices.description: A service to customize foundation models to learn operational workflows and autonomously perform actions and generate formatted content.
productsAndServices.name: Autonomous Agent Builder
